note: All sizes at 1x. Use image-rendering: pixelated and integer zoom (var(--px)).

frame-stone.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(8px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/frame-stone.png') 8 fill round;

frame-gilded.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(8px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/frame-gilded.png') 8 fill round;
frame-gilded.style: B: gilded dialogue frame with rivets

frame-inset.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(8px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/frame-inset.png') 8 fill round;
frame-inset.style: sunken well for viewports and lists

title-bar.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(8px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/title-bar.png') 8 fill round;
title-bar.note: left slice holds the bloom diamond; text goes after 10px*px

button-primary-hover.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(4px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/button-primary-hover.png') 4 fill round;

button-primary-pressed.css: border-style: solid; border-width: calc(4px * var(--px)); border-image: url('widgets/button-primary-pressed.png') 4 fill round;
